subject.title: feat: add Baseten Model API provider

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor Baseten as an official external provider, including ongoing package, catalog, documentation, and reasoning-compatibility ownership?
rationale: The technical implementation fits the plugin architecture, but official-provider status creates a durable product and maintenance commitment that repository automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor Official Provider
options.body: Accept the external package into the official catalog with a named owner for publication, catalog freshness, and provider-contract maintenance.

options.title: Route Community-Only
options.body: Keep the implementation external but remove official catalog and documentation promotion so it can publish independently through ClawHub and npm.

options.title: Pause for Ownership
options.body: Hold the PR until a maintainer explicitly accepts long-term ownership of Baseten compatibility and release coordination.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Official Provider
recommendation.body: Accept the external package into the official catalog with a named owner for publication, catalog freshness, and provider-contract maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history covers the relevant provider/replay infrastructure and they applied the item-specific provider and maintainer labels.
